purpose: Correct only the two technical provenance failures observed in V0.1 without changing any scientific hypothesis, signal, outcome, symbol set, capture duration, or trading policy.

coinbase_advanced_sequence_model.reason: Captured V0.1 raw data showed sequence_num interleaving products and channels at the connection-envelope level; per-book +1 adjacency therefore produced false gap violations.
frozen_rule: Validate exact +1 sequence continuity across every received Coinbase Advanced connection envelope before channel/product filtering.
At per-book application level require strictly increasing, non-regressing sequence_num; adjacency is not required because unrelated products/channels can intervene.
Any genuine connection-level gap or reordering invalidates provenance fail-closed.

binance_public_market_data_hosts.reason: V0.1 standard Binance Spot WebSocket returned HTTP 451 on the GitHub-hosted runner before any message was captured.
binance_public_market_data_hosts.justification: Binance official Spot API documentation designates data-stream.binance.vision and data-api.binance.vision as market-data-only/public endpoints and states that user data streams are unavailable through the market-data-only WebSocket host.
binance_public_market_data_hosts.not_a_bypass: No VPN, proxy, relay, IP masking, alternate account, or geographic circumvention is authorized or used. If the official market-data-only host is unavailable from the runner, V0.2 must fail closed.

classification_policy.pass: Both venues produce non-empty public market-data capture, required books synchronize, Coinbase connection sequence remains continuous, raw segments are hashed, and no guard is violated.
classification_policy.fail: Any network/access, sequence, parser, synchronization, storage, or provenance-integrity failure causes PROVENANCE_GATE_FAIL.
classification_policy.scientific_meaning: PASS or FAIL is a data/provenance infrastructure result only. It is not evidence for or against a trading edge.

forbidden: Change symbols, channels, capture duration, or synchronization rules after seeing V0.2 output.
Open H02, derive signals, measure profitability, or inspect target outcomes from this provenance run.
Use authenticated endpoints, account endpoints, orders, trading routes, VPNs, proxies, relays, or geographic circumvention.
Silently fall back to another venue or data source if either frozen venue fails.
